title: 1999 HMMT Feb Algebra Problem 2
statement: For what single digit \(n\) does 91 divide the 9 -digit number \(12345 n 789\) ?

solutions.text: For those who don't like long division, there is a quicker way. First notice that \(91=7 \cdot 13\), and \(7 \cdot 11 \cdot 13=1001\). Observe that \(12345 n 789=123 \cdot 1001000+45 n \cdot 1001-123 \cdot 1001+123-45 n+789\) It follows that 91 will divide \(12345 n 789\) iff 91 divides \(123-45 n+789=462-n\). The number 462 is divisible by 7 and leaves a remainder of \(\mathbf{7}\) when divided by 13 .
